title: jams engine input script, format v1

$schema.description: The input-script JSON Schema this file follows.

scene.description: The scene this script was written for; a run against another scene is refused.

at.description: Play from here instead of the game's spawn, cast along the game's spawn direction (gravity by default) onto the first surface it meets; refused inside a solid.

prefixItems.description: y in world pixels; y is down.

timeOffsetMs.description: Advance time-driven entities (followers) by this much before tick 0.

maxTicks.description: The run ends as `timeout` after this many ticks (default 1800, 30 s).

steps.description: The steps, played in order from tick 0.

description: A headless playtest: steps of held actions at 60 ticks a second. The run ends when the game's outcome hook decides, when the steps run out (`script-end`), at `maxTicks` (`timeout`), or `stuck` (a movement action held with the focus moving under 4 px in 120 ticks).

hold.description: Every action held during the step; what the step before held and this one doesn't is released when it starts. Empty holds nothing.

for.description: Hold for this many ticks (60 a second).

anyOf.description: Hold actions for a fixed number of ticks.

hold.description: Every action held during the step; what the step before held and this one doesn't is released when it starts. Empty holds nothing.

forMs.description: Hold for this many milliseconds, rounded to whole 60 Hz ticks (at least one).

anyOf.description: Hold actions for a duration in milliseconds.

hold.description: Every action held during the step; what the step before held and this one doesn't is released when it starts. Empty holds nothing.

max.description: Give up waiting after this many ticks and go on to the next step (default 600).

anyOf.description: Hold actions until a condition holds, capped by `max` ticks.

press.description: The action or actions to press.

anyOf.description: Press for one tick: the actions go down at the step's tick and up at the next. Nothing else is held.

wait.description: Hold nothing for this many ticks.

anyOf.description: Release everything for a number of ticks.

command.description: A command name; this registry's game declares none.

args.description: The command's arguments, checked by its `args` schema; omit for none.

anyOf.description: Send a command for one slot, still holding what the hold step before it held (nothing after a press or wait). It wakes a turns or event game.

elapse.description: Milliseconds away, sent as `@elapsed`; this game has no `time.catchUp`, so it refuses the step.

anyOf.description: Report wall time away for one slot, as `@elapsed`, still holding what the hold step before it held (nothing after a press or wait). It wakes every game.

Step.description: One step: `hold` with exactly one of `for`, `forMs` or `until`; `press`; `wait`; `command`; or `elapse`.

Action.description: An action name; this registry has no game, so it declares none.

tick.description: Holds once this absolute tick (from 0) is reached or passed.

Until.description: Ends the step on the first tick where every key holds (AND), checked after each tick, so the step runs at least one tick. Predicates: event, tick.

entityId.description: The entity the event must name, e.g. the sensor for `sensor:enter`.

other.description: The other entity it must name, e.g. what entered the sensor.

anyOf.description: An event type with the entity ids it must name.

EventMatch.description: Holds on a tick that raised a matching event.
